notes: The and of threescore and ten stands inside one numeral's fixed rendering rather than between two source numerals, so it joins שִׁבְעִים's unit and is neither added nor a waw's (rules 14, 42); the head is on threescore, with ten the competing reading since no single word carries seventy.
בְּנֵי בָנִים is rendered as an English possessive, so the rectum takes the possessor's word standing first and the construct takes the head noun (rule 29); no determiner is written for either.

The articleless participle רֹכְבִים follows the noun it modifies with no subject pronoun and no coordinated finite clause, so it is attributive and keeps the supplied relative that with itself (rule 41).
עֲיָרִם → ass colts heads on colts by rule 31's subtraction; heading on ass, treating colts as the supplied generic, is the competing reading.
וַיְהִי־לוֹ divides as rule 43 directs: had on the existential, the לְ unrepresented, he on the suffix.
